requested_outcome: Transform the live Spa discovery page from a sparse generic layout into a premium, fast, clear VII experience and publish the complete approved branch without losing the administration and search-demand work already completed.
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests, Git push and the user's repeatedly authorized VII production publication are allowed. Do not change supplier catalogs, domains, secrets, bindings or trigger supplier pulls.

lesson_bundle.reason: The terse rejection requires translating the visible defect into the complete experience Adir will test.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact live Spa page must be inspected as a customer, not approved from code or build output.

lesson_bundle.reason: The changed hero, search and filter rail are responsive shared UI states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Desktop, 390-pixel mobile and breakpoint transitions must retain content, state and usable controls.

lesson_bundle.reason: The rejection was triggered by the visible mobile composition and empty space.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: A real 390-pixel capture must show meaningful content and no unexplained empty band.

lesson_bundle.reason: The Spa page is a public customer surface with navigation, filters, cards and map behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The full visible journey, loading feedback and live destination require regression evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The branch contains newer administration and tracking work than production Site 412.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Publication must preserve the complete baseline, exact commit identity and rollback version, followed by live verification.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The first screen still feels empty, generic and unfinished.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build a compact image-led Spa hero with one clear search action and measured spacing.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and 390-pixel captures show title, value, real Spa imagery and search without a large empty band.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The filter icons still look like a technical grid and push the results below the fold.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a deliberate horizontal experience rail on mobile and a compact premium category strip on desktop.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The result count and first result remain reachable quickly, with no two-row mobile filter wall.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Clicking a Spa category still gives no immediate acknowledgement.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add local pending state, spinner, accessible busy semantics and selected styling to the initiating category.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A category click changes the clicked control immediately and resolves to a matching URL, heading, count and results.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The redesign looks better locally but the live site still shows the old version or loses recent admin work.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish only an immutable commit containing the current branch history and verify the exact live routes after deployment.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The live Spa page and the administration command center both expose the new release, with Site 412 retained for rollback.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Hebrew typography or mobile alignment still feels old or inconsistent.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reuse the approved modern sans stack and inspect headings, buttons, chips and results on both viewports.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Rendered controls use the approved Heebo/Rubik/Assistant sans family with clean RTL geometry and no clipping.

affected_family: default, pending, selected, reset, empty and map states

sources.label: VII Spa search and results behavior standard
Existing approved real Spa catalog images and data

midpoint_gate.trigger: First local desktop and 390-pixel render of the redesigned hero and filter rail
checks: filter rail does not become a two-row wall
result cards and count remain visually connected

attack_questions: Can a user still reach results quickly on a 390-pixel screen?
Does a filter click acknowledge immediately and preserve URL-backed state after reload and back?
Did the shared Spa landing family retain correct titles, breadcrumbs, selected chips and result counts?
Did publication overwrite or omit the newer administration and search-demand work?
Does any changed Hebrew control clip, wrap badly or fall back to an old font?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Live desktop and 390-pixel captures plus exercised search, category filter, reset, map and back flow on https://vii.spaplus.co/spas.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Representative base, feature and semantic search routes plus administration routes on the exact deployed version.

effectiveness.baseline: Production Site 412 shows a sparse heading area and a large multi-row filter wall before results; the newer admin and search-demand commit is not yet live.
effectiveness.target: One release candidate that visibly improves the first viewport, acknowledges interaction, preserves the full branch baseline and passes local and live release gates.
